description: A colored pill/chip that shows DistortionType (A/B/C/D) and PolicyImplication for one study. Color-coded: A=red (stratify-immediately), B=orange (investigate-confounder), C=yellow (check-allocation-bias), D=green (pooled-analysis-trustworthy).
visual_spec: Pill shape, 2–3 chars for the type letter, tooltip on hover showing PolicyImplication text. Consistent color across all screens.
name: comp-01-distortion-badge

description: A side-by-side horizontal bar chart comparing PooledRateA vs PooledRateB (or StratumRateA vs StratumRateB for strata). The bar for the loser under equal-weight allocation is visually distinguished from the bar for the pooled loser.
required_fields: PooledRateA, PooledRateB, PooledWinner, WeightedStratumGapSum, SignedPooledGap, IsSignFlip
visual_spec: Two horizontal bars, labeled A and B. Arrow or bracket showing the gap. IsSignFlip=TRUE triggers a 'reversal' annotation. Width proportional to rate (0–1 scale).
name: comp-02-rate-comparison-bar

description: A grid of (Stratum × Treatment) cells where cell color encodes AllocationBias magnitude and sign. Positive bias (A over-allocated here) in one color; negative (B over-allocated) in another. Cell text shows AllocationFractionA and AllocationFractionB.
required_fields: StratumLabel, TreatmentLabel, AllocationBias, AllocationFractionA, AllocationFractionB, StratumSuccessRate
visual_spec: Matrix layout: rows=strata, cols=treatments. Diverging color scale centered at 0. Tooltip shows raw Cases and Successes from CaseCells.
name: comp-03-allocation-heatmap

description: A 2D scatter plot with AllocationDistortion on the x-axis and ReversalIntensity on the y-axis. Each point is one study, colored by DistortionType. Quadrant lines at AllocationDistortion=0.01 (threshold) and ReversalIntensity=1.0 (unanimity) divide the plane into the four types.
visual_spec: SVG or canvas scatter. Labeled quadrant regions. Clickable points. Legend showing type → color → policy action.
name: comp-04-distortion-plane-scatter

description: A waterfall chart showing how each stratum's WeightedStratumGap contributes to WeightedStratumGapSum, then how the allocation re-weights them to produce SignedPooledGap. The visual makes the mechanism equation explicit: pooled = Σ(weight × rate).
required_fields: StratumLabel, StratumGap, StratumFraction, WeightedStratumGap, WeightedStratumGapSum, SignedPooledGap
visual_spec: Waterfall/stacked bar: each stratum's WeightedStratumGap as a segment; running sum shown; final total vs actual SignedPooledGap shown side-by-side. IsSignFlip highlights the sign difference.
name: comp-05-stratum-gap-waterfall

description: A summary scorecard showing all ModelSummary fields as labeled metric tiles: StudyCount, ReversalCount, ExplainedCount, TypeA/B/C/D counts, AvgAllocationDistortion, TotalParadoxStrength.
visual_spec: Grid of metric tiles. Each tile: large number, small label. Color: ReversalCount in orange/red; ExplainedCount in green; TypeD in grey. Single row layout on desktop, 2-column on mobile.
name: comp-06-model-summary-scorecard

description: A card showing one StratumVariable row: VariableName, CausalRole badge, AffectsTreatmentAssignment checkbox, AffectsOutcome checkbox, IsConfounder result, and MechanismNote prose block.
required_fields: VariableName, CausalRole, AffectsTreatmentAssignment, AffectsOutcome, IsConfounder, MechanismNote
visual_spec: Card with header=VariableName, CausalRole as a badge (confounder=red, mediator=orange, contested=yellow, unknown=grey), two boolean indicators, and MechanismNote as body text.
name: comp-07-confounder-card

description: A vertical timeline of all Loops rows, grouped by Status. Each entry shows LoopId, Title, Status indicator, NewConcept chip, and an expandable section with DomainQuestion, MockDataNote, and NextSuggestion.
required_fields: LoopId, Title, Status, NewConcept, DomainQuestion, MockDataNote, NextSuggestion
visual_spec: Vertical list. Status=complete: solid circle; in-progress: half-filled; planned: open circle. Expandable accordion per entry. Color: complete=green, in-progress=blue, planned=grey.
name: comp-08-loop-timeline

description: A prominent banner at the top of the Study Detail screen showing PolicyImplication as a clear action statement, color-coded by DistortionType. Includes a one-sentence explanation of why this action follows from the geometry.
visual_spec: Full-width colored banner. Large icon (e.g. warning triangle for A, magnifying glass for B, scale for C, checkmark for D). Bold action text. Secondary line explaining the geometric basis.
name: comp-09-policy-action-banner

description: A filterable list of Conclusions rows grouped by Category and Status. Each entry shows the Title, Status badge, Evidence summary, and a link to the WitnessedInLoop or TargetLoop.
required_fields: Category, Status, Title, Evidence, WitnessedInLoop, TargetLoop
visual_spec: Grouped list with category headers. Status badge: witnessed=green, planned=blue, open=orange. Evidence shown as collapsed text (expand on click). Loop links navigate to LoopTimeline.
name: comp-10-conclusion-list

description: Grouped hypothesis cards with observed metrics, PASS/FAIL badges, and a study table filtered by StratumCausalRole × flip mode (manifest / latent-only / stable).
required_fields: HypothesisId, HypothesisStatement, ObservedMetric, IsConfirmed, Evidence, WitnessedInLoop
visual_spec: Two sections: hypothesis cards (green PASS / red FAIL) then study table with columns Study, StratumCausalRole, IsSignFlip, PooledGapCrossesZero, IsLatentOnlyFlip, DistortionType.
name: comp-11-discovery-panel
